_comment: Shared vectors pinning core/citations.py::normalise_title/title_key against browser-extension/src/paper.js::normaliseTitle/titleKey. Both suites read this file. A change to either normaliser fails here until the other changes too -- which is the point: a title that hashes differently on the two sides is a paper the extension silently fails to recognise. `doi_vectors` pins normalise_doi against paper.js::normaliseDoi for the same reason: a DOI stored in one case and looked up in another is a map of near misses.
